read_boundary.candidate_query: Original bounded account-day close-fill query; maximum 501.

exit_classification_basis: Last filled closing request; not all legs and not causal attribution.

entry_reference_deviation.interpretation: Signed actual-quantity reference differences, NOT proven slippage or recoverable profit.

priorities.hypothesis: Entry reference and executable quote are misaligned.
priorities.check: Same-environment quote source, timestamp, validity, spread and order-to-fill delay; preserve position risk and hard stops.
priorities.falsification: If differences are caused by mark/reference-time convention rather than attainable quotes, do not report savings or tighten execution based on them.

priorities.hypothesis: Early structural failure explains first-hour losses.
priorities.check: Use all retained candidates, not only trades or daily movers; single-factor entry-feature alternatives, frozen inputs, matched direction/volatility/cost and chronological holdout.
priorities.falsification: Reject a filter if missed winners and waiting costs exceed avoided losses. Do not force a minimum hold based on survivors.

priorities.hypothesis: Trend residual positions and stagnating positions need distinct exit comparisons.
priorities.check: Freeze original entries, hard stops and risk. Compare structural continuation versus baseline using same-environment executable paths, costs, capital occupation and adverse excursions.
priorities.falsification: Reject longer holding if it adds drawdown without net performance improvement; do not remove peak protection from profitable outcome-conditioned groups.

constraints: No global volume-gate relaxation: 11/24 reconstructed 100 inputs had 8 volume-gate changes but only 1 new market candidate; not proof of a profitable trade.
Do not increase leverage or remove protective stops from these one-day findings.
Unavailable paths, funding decomposition or frozen flow remain unknown; do not invent them.

limitations: Last-close-day whole-episode settlement is not equity-day return.
Funding is not inferred from gross/net/fee differences.
Exit-reason groups are post-outcome groups, not alternative strategy backtests.
Longer-held winners do not prove a minimum-hold rule.
Direct source does not capture every TV contribution; two direct TV trades cannot establish effectiveness.
One-day exploratory evidence is not out-of-sample validation.
